description:
Custom Maid 3D 2 ver 1.50 + All DLC

This is a torrent that contains the latest version of Custom Maid 3D 2(version 1.50) and with all of the game's DLC preinstalled.

It is ideal for people wanting to try the game for the first time (but don't want to spend hours installing DLC) and for veteran players who need a fresh reinstall.

Only original files are included. If you need mod support or translations please consider getting the Sybaris AIO or Sybaris Starter Pack. As a fair warning, please don't use the Hongfire Patch with this version as it is over a year old and will break your game.
